why: issue 1535/1787 -- the word nros-cpp stamps at offset 0 of its executor context. It is public only so nros-cpp and nros share one definition: the Rust component-install seam reads it to refuse a C/C++ handle that was not unwrapped with `nros_cpp_executor_inner`. ROS 2 has no equivalent because rclcpp never passes a C++ executor to a Rust callee.
